references.name: reference/salvage-ground
references.shows: The whole island town from the sea, and out in front of the quay, past a band of open deep water, the salvage ground: low wide sandbars joined into one irregular shallow patch, pale turquoise shallows shading to deep blue, a curving broken outer bar, six barrels afloat in the channels. The style anchor for the series.

references.name: reference/from-the-castle
references.shows: The town from the castle gate on the summit in mid-morning: the castle road below, the square with the festival stage, the main street down to the quay, the lighthouse, the salvage ground out at sea.

references.name: reference/plan
references.shows: The island as a straight-down plan at noon: the castle on its mountain, the road down to the square and stage, the main street to the quay, farms, pens and orchards on the flanks, the lighthouse, and the salvage ground offshore.

references.name: reference/harbour-at-dusk
references.shows: The harbour at sunset from the water off the quay: the raiders' longboats rowing in, townsfolk with torches on the quay, the lighthouse lamp lit, the town's windows and lanterns coming on.

references.name: reference/festival-night
references.shows: The cathedral square at night: the town gathered round the stage, bunting and hanging lanterns across the streets, lit windows, a lavish firework show over the square and the dark sea beyond.
